latestVersion.changelog:
Shotcut 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edit and export videos up to 500MB via simple chat commands.
- Supports automatic silent trimming, scene cuts, and smooth transitions — just describe what you want.
- Handles a wide range of formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV for video; plus common image and audio types).
- One-click export to 1080p MP4; finished jobs delivered in about 30–90 seconds.
- Automatic token and session management; prompts for user login only if needed.
- Credits, timeline, and state management all accessible via chat prompts.
